title: Purple aura above treetops and Bledsoe's 'they're gone now'

tellings.quote: purple ARA that looked like purple glowy smoke right above the Treetops

plain: At the North Carolina home of Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, a witness saw a "purple glowy smoke right above the treetops," after which Bledsoe said, "they're gone now." The witness is Bob McGwier, introduced on the show as a CIA contractor, who tells it as something he saw himself. If true, it suggests that something visible really came and went around Bledsoe.
